summary: Jokoo Partners (ambassadors) Phase 1 backend — 30/30 tests PASSED (100%). All 17 requirements from the review request verified: admin toggle/list/config/commission endpoints, self endpoints (/me, /me/referrals, /me/commissions), public leaderboard (no monetary data leak), resolve/invite public endpoints, /auth/register auto-attach hook (pending referral created), self-referral blocked, rate-limit 20/IP/day enforced, KYC hook, and booking-completion hook (correct rate + amount + idempotence + tier snapshot). No blocker found.
action_items: Ready to move to Phase 2 (UI wiring / Next.js SSR landing / deep-link handler). No backend fix needed.

OPTIONAL — minor DX improvement: consider tightening self-attach to return an explicit 400 ('self-referral not allowed') instead of a silent {ok: false}, so the mobile UI can display a clean error. Currently the endpoint returns 200 with {ok: false, ambassador_id: null} which is fine but ambiguous.
critical_code_review_comments: ambassadors.py is well-isolated, ~900 lines — module-level split is not urgent yet.
Hook _amb_hook_booking_completed uses booking `total_xof || price_xof || amount_xof` fallbacks — good.
Anti-fraud path in hook_user_registered correctly handles: (a) self-referral (same user_id), (b) rate limit via ip_hash, (c) idempotency (one referral per user).
Commission idempotency: enforced via unique (ambassador_id, booking_id) lookup — verified in test.
Public leaderboard correctly hides monetary data (name/tier/prestataires/clients only).
PII: /me/referrals correctly strips ip_hash / email_hash / phone_hash from response.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed created. All test rows (users, referrals, commissions) generated during pytest were cleaned up. Aïda ambassador state restored to original: verified_count=1, pending_count=2, 3 referrals, 1 commission.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_ambassadors_p1.py can be re-run standalone (pytest tests/test_ambassadors_p1.py). It auto-cleans its own DB inserts for hooks/rate-limit tests. HTTP-level register tests leave TEST_amb_*@example.com users behind — clean via `db.users.delete_many({'email': {'$regex': 'test_amb_.*@example.com'}})` and delete their ambassador_referrals rows by referred_user_id. Aïda (client@jokoo.sn) is the seeded ambassador — code=5GB3EH, slug=aida-client, tier=starter.
